summary: TrendAI Vision One Forensics: digital forensics right in the platform console, with evidence collection from computers and its analysis.
value: After an incident it shows how the attacker got in and what they did.
Evidence is collected from computers remotely, without separate tools.
Investigations are faster because everything is in one console.
simple: Digital forensics right in the platform console, with no separate tools: collects evidence from computers, organizes it in workspaces, quickly triages computers with osquery queries and YARA rules, and builds a single super timeline and report enriched with threat intelligence. Requires XDR for Endpoints (EDR); licensed by evidence storage volume (Evidence Collection). Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
notIncluded: EDR is required on the computers.
